title: "Financial Procedures"

This section provides guidance on the main financial and administrative procedures used by the OSC, including payments, reimbursements, income, account management, and commonly used forms.

## Pages in this section

| Page | Description |
|---|---|

| [Business Travel](business-travel.qmd) | Information and procedure instructions for reimbursement for business travel by OSC staff. |
| [Purchasing](purchasing.qmd) | This page details procedures for purchasing goods and services and processing invoices. |
| [Income](income.qmd) | Find here information and instructions for invoicing OSC services and receiving institutional membership fees. |
| [Checking Balance](balance.qmd) | This page contains information on monthly procedures for checking account balances and financial records. |
